items.summary: The Supreme Court will NOT hear the Rahul Gandhi-led SIR writ petition (Diary 64196/2026) on Tuesday, Oct 13. The registry's 14 defects - missing vakalatnamas for 9 of the 11 petitioners, a Rs 220 court-fee shortfall, an illegible copy of Mallikarjun Kharge's ID, and individual ECs named as respondents - must be cured before the matter can be listed. The petitioners' legal team has requested the matter be listed on Wednesday, Oct 14 after the defects are cured. (Defects were flagged Oct 12; the Tuesday non-hearing + Wednesday re-list request is new, confirmed by Hindustan Times, The Bengal Today and TezzBuzz.)
items.title: SC SIR petition: Tuesday hearing off; petitioners seek Wednesday listing after curing 14 registry defects

items.summary: Dipke's first Instagram reaction to Tuesday morning's Jantar Mantar re-detention: caption 'Waiving Tiranga at Jantar Mantar! You cannot de-notify the movement, Modi!' (~55K likes). Mirrors his already-reported X statement naming Das, Ranka and Ajinkya Shinde as detained. He also posted IG stories ('Waiving the Tiranga at Jantar Mantar - Well done Cockroaches!' / 'Bravo team!').
items.title: Dipke's first Instagram reaction to Tuesday's Jantar Mantar re-detention

items.summary: CJP national spokesperson Ashutosh Ranka posted his own IG reel captioned 'Fortress Jantar Mantar has been breached' - his own on-the-scene voice on Tuesday morning's gate-climb that led to his and Saurav Das's re-detention. Participant's own post corroborates the detention from the CJP side.
items.title: Ranka's own IG reel from the gate-climb: 'Fortress Jantar Mantar has been breached'
